phase: Generation 17 - Shopify Hardening via Real-Store Shakedown

validations_executed.evidence: Allbirds (footwear), Brooklinen (home goods), Gymshark (athletic apparel), Bombas (socks), ColourPop (beauty) each ran the full cycle. Pipeline robust: every stage succeeded or degraded honestly, no crashes. Platform detected Shopify at High confidence on 4/5; Bombas fell to unknown because its public JSON endpoints 404. Six findings recorded (FND-GEN017-001..006).

validations_executed.tool: curate-query-pack.mjs operational filter + taxonomy leaf extraction
validations_executed.evidence: Expanded the operational/back-end collection blocklist (tier, msrp, price, discount(s), protection, package, content, all-products, add-on, version tags, commas) applied to both collection titles/handles and product_type values, plus taxonomy-path leaf extraction. Re-curation from retained evidence (no site contact) cleaned Brooklinen and ColourPop fully and Gymshark's taxonomy paths; two minor edge leaks remain, intentionally not over-tuned on five stores.
All pass after the curation change, including the dashboard validator's curation attribute-relationship assertion.

validations_skipped.reason: GEN-017 remains open; the endpoint-fallback and coverage-guard findings (FND-GEN017-002, -003) are still backlog. Phase exit deferred until the hardening backlog is triaged.
validations_skipped.revisit_when: After the operator prioritizes the remaining shakedown findings.

high_findings: FND-GEN017-001 curation operational-collection leakage (fixed in this run)
notes: Shakedown delivered its purpose: it found real weaknesses that boutique-only testing never would. The dominant one (curation quality) is fixed; the rest are triaged as backlog for operator prioritization before GEN-017 phase exit.
